NTA AISSEE Sainik School Admission Online Form 2027 – Full Details

National Testing Agency (NTA) has released the notification for the All India Sainik School Entrance Exam AISSEE Admission 2027. The online application process for NTA AISSEE Sainik School Admission Online Form 2027 has started on 03 November 2026, and candidates can apply till 02 December 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for NTA AISSEE Sainik School Admission Online Form 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 03 November 2026
  • Last Date : 02 December 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 02 December 2026
  • Correction Date : 07-09 December 2026
  • Exam Date : 31 January 2027
  • Exam City Details : 11 January 2027
  • Admit Card : 25 January 2027

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 850/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 700/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

  • Apply Online

  • Download Notification
  • Official Website
